subject: Physical Education
title: Move, Stretch & Play
subtitle: Building healthy movement habits together
warmUp: 5 minutes of walking, arm circles, high knees, and gentle dynamic stretching.
skillFocus: Body control, coordination, balance, and safe movement.
workout: Complete a simple circuit of jumping jacks, bodyweight squats, walking or jogging, and balance exercises.
game: Finish with a short family movement game or relay.
fitnessFocus: Cardiovascular endurance, coordination, mobility, and general fitness.
outdoorActivity: Complete the walking or jogging portion outdoors when weather permits.
coolDown: Walk slowly for several minutes, stretch the major muscle groups, and drink water.

studentModifications.modification: Complete the full activity and focus on controlled form and consistent effort.
Complete the activity at a comfortable pace with emphasis on coordination and proper movement.
Use shorter exercise intervals as needed and focus on learning each movement correctly.

theme: Physical education develops healthy movement, strength, coordination, perseverance, and habits that support an active life.
